preceding_paragraph: Table S16 | All prespecified inference settings. Top-1 (%) is mean ± sample s.d. over five measurement-noise realizations, each with the same 540 queries and strictly rebuilt retained artifacts. Setting names identify changes from the unchanged default; exact configurations are supplied in Source Data and the frozen design. All settings are retained, including decreases. This is a one-factor sensitivity grid, not an exhaustive factorial search or independent selection of an optimum.

intended_caption: Table S17 | Node-held-out test of the frozen estimator choice. Values are Top-1 partition accuracy on 1,350 test queries per protocol. The projection choice and all masking parameters were selected using the separate 1,350-query development split; the test set was evaluated once. Cosine and recomputed projection were identical on every test query. McNemar P values compare the frozen masked projection with the unmasked projection on paired test queries.
